full_text_en:
Taizhou Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Dai Yining et al. — drug trafficking case

Ruling Summary

Where a case is remanded for retrial because a death sentence was not approved, both the original court of first instance and the original court of second instance shall form a new collegial panel to conduct the trial. Where the original court of second instance fails to form a new collegial panel during the retrial, this constitutes a procedural violation of the trial.

Supreme People's Court
Criminal Ruling

(2005) Xing Fu Zi No. 84

Defendant Dai Yining, male, born May 18, 1974, Han ethnicity, from Wuhan City, Hubei Province, high school education, unemployed, residing at No. 2, 4th Floor, 406 Tianmendun Road, Jianghan District, Wuhan. Arrested on December 29, 2000. Currently in custody.

Defendant Zhao Libin, male, born April 4, 1975, Han ethnicity, from Nenjiang County, Heilongjiang Province, junior high school education, farmer, residing at Jinling Village, Menluhe Township, Nenjiang County. Arrested on December 29, 2000. Currently in custody.

Defendant Lv Xiaoli, female, born October 26, 1974, Han ethnicity, from Leshan City, Sichuan Province, junior high school education, farmer, residing at Group 7, Qiaogou Street, Qiaogou Town, Wutongqiao District, Leshan City. Arrested on December 29, 2000. Currently in custody.

Defendant Dong Zhiying, female, born September 6, 1982, Han ethnicity, from Zhongshan County, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, primary school education, farmer, residing at No. 1 Yumiaotang Village, Chengxiang Town, Zhongshan County. Arrested on December 29, 2000. Currently in custody.

Defendant Zhang Xuejuan, female, born April 7, 1970, Han ethnicity, from Wenling City, Zhejiang Province, primary school education, farmer, residing at Baishuitian Village, Ruoheng Town, Wenling City. Arrested on July 27, 2000. Currently in custody.

The Taizhou Intermediate People's Court of Zhejiang Province, having tried the case initiated by the Taizhou Municipal People's Procuratorate charging the defendants Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan with the crime of drug trafficking and drug transportation, rendered a criminal judgment on October 23, 2001, (2001) Tai Xing Yi Chu Zi No. 74, finding the defendants Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan guilty of the crime of drug trafficking, sentencing each to death, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property. After the judgment was pronounced, Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan refused to accept it and all appealed. The Zhejiang High People's Court, on December 30, 2002, rendered a criminal judgment (2001) Zhe Xing Yi Zhong Zi No. 393, dismissing the appeal, affirming the original judgment, and reported the case to our court for approval in accordance with the law. Our court, on November 6, 2003, issued a criminal ruling (2003) Xing Fu Zi No. 140, setting aside the part concerning the conviction and sentencing of defendants Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan in the criminal judgment of Zhejiang High People's Court (2001) Zhe Xing Yi Zhong Zi No. 393 and the criminal judgment of Taizhou Intermediate People's Court (2001) Tai Xing Yi Chu Zi No. 74; and remanded the case to Taizhou Intermediate People's Court for retrial. Taizhou Intermediate People's Court, after retrying the case, rendered a criminal judgment on February 10, 2004, (2004) Tai Xing Yi Chong Zi No. 1, finding the defendants Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan guilty of the crime of drug trafficking, sentencing each to death, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property. After the judgment was pronounced, Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan refused to accept it and all appealed. The Zhejiang High People's Court, on December 14, 2004, issued a criminal ruling (2004) Zhe Xing Yi Zhong Zi No. 139, dismissing the appeal, affirming the original judgment, and reported the case to our court for approval in accordance with the law. Our court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to review this case. The review has now concluded.

Our court holds that, during the retrial of the case involving the defendants Dai Yining, Zhao Libin, Lv Xiaoli, Dong Zhiying, and Zhang Xuejuan for drug trafficking, the court of second instance failed to form a new collegial panel to conduct the trial of this case. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 199 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Item (4) of Article 285 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

1. The criminal ruling of the Zhejiang High People's Court (2004) Zhe Xing Yi Zhong Zi No. 139 is set aside;

2. The case is remanded to the Zhejiang High People's Court for retrial.

This ruling shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Du Weifu
Acting Judge: Cheng Yongsheng
Acting Judge: Dong Chaoyang

May 31, 2005

Clerk: Li Xiuyuan

[Profile of the Presiding Judge]

Du Weifu, Senior Judge: Born in 1951, holds a bachelor's degree in law, served as a judge of the Supreme People's Court since 1994.
